about.title: About Me
about.name: KiJeong Yang
about.p1: I turn ideas into real products.
about.p2: Starting with a simple order-recording app I built while working as a server in 2017, I have worked across the full spectrum of product development — Android, AOSP, embedded systems, web, backend, deployment, and operations.
about.p3: Beyond just implementing features, I focus on reliably solving real user problems in production environments.
about.p4: Currently at an AIoT solutions company, I handle end-to-end IoT product development: RK3588-based Android/Linux gateway development, Modbus/BLE/Sub-G sensor integration, and cloud monitoring platform connectivity.
